name: E2E-SEEDV-016 — 种草视频类目开关SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS验证
description: 验证种草视频链路同样受SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS开关控制。开关默认[16](女装)，P1级别支持Diamond推送。视频链路与图文链路共用同一开关，修改后双链路同时生效。
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'video-switch-validation', scenario: '视频类目开关验证', switchName: 'SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS', sharedWithImage: true, videoSpecific: { filterAppliedTo: ['F88SeedVideoGenerateCronTrigger(定时任务)', 'F88ItemDiagnosisMessageService#isClothingItemForSeed(MetaQ)'], pipelineConfig: 'pipelineSeedVideo独立于pipelineSeed', totalSwitch: '视频总开关(总控) + 类目开关(过滤)双层控制' }, verification: { switchPlatform: 'switch.pre.alibaba-inc.com', defaultCheck: '默认值[16]与代码一致', pushEffect: '推送后视频链路下一批次立即生效', dualEffect: '修改同时影响图文和视频链路' } }; })()
steps.description: 定义视频类目开关规则

steps.expression: (() => { const s = ${videoSwitchSpec}; return { validation: '视频类目开关规则', checks: [ { name: '图文视频共用开关', expected: '同一SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS', rule: '修改同时影响双链路', pass: true }, { name: '视频双层控制', expected: '总开关+类目开关', rule: '总开关OFF→不触发; 类目过滤→非女装不触发', pass: true }, { name: '默认值一致', expected: '[16]', rule: 'singletonList(16L)', pass: true }, { name: 'P1推送生效', expected: '运行时推送无需重启', rule: '@AppSwitch(level=P1)', pass: true }, { name: '视频链路号独立', expected: 'pipelineSeedVideo ≠ pipelineSeed', rule: 'Diamond配置各自独立', pass: true } ] }; })()
steps.description: 验证视频类目开关规则全项

steps.label: seedv-clothing-cate-switch
steps.description: 截图 - 视频类目开关验证

_testDesign.stepsText: 1.确认SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS默认值[16] 2.验证图文视频共用 3.验证P1推送生效 4.验证双层控制(总开关+类目开关)
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①开关默认[16] ②修改同时影响图文和视频 ③推送后下一批次生效
riskPoints: 空列表会导致双链路全量过滤
视频总开关OFF时类目过滤无意义(本身就不触发)
